title: Bed detector system
description: While interning at Chinougijutsu, an AI and robotics consulting startup company, I had to research how to track a person in a hospital and nursing home setting to identify when they are about to fall and notify staff to prevent the fall. I looked at many different APIS, such as YOLO and OpenPose, to test how they worked on existing data and which one to use.
technologies: Python, LLM Models, Openpose, YOLO framework
